verdict.rationale: The only product-operation evidence is a single marketing line saying users can "describe the task, review the plan and cost, approve the run, and get a trained model." That implies a natural-language guided path for fine-tuning, but it is not documented in any depth. Tool calling and the OpenAI-compatible API are developer building blocks, and Nexus CLI connects coding tools rather than operating Fireworks itself, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of deployments, models and billing; first-party docs detailing the guided fine-tuning flow; independent or hands-on corroboration.
